english.title: Fail to give notice of change affecting entitlement to reduction in council tax reduction scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: council tax reduction schemes detection of fraud and enforcement wales regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) following a change in circumstances which you knew would affect your entitlement to a reduction, or the amount of your reduction, under an authority's council tax reduction scheme, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHANGE IN CIRCUMSTANCES..), failed to give a prompt notification of that change in the manner required by the provision included in the authority's council tax reduction scheme by virtue of paragraph 7 of Schedule 13 to the Prescribed Requirements Regulations or by paragraph 113 of the Default Scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation8(1) and (5) of the Council Tax Reduction Schemes (Detection of Fraud andEnforcement) (Wales) Regulations 2013.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Notification of a change is prompt if, and only if, it is given within a period of 21 days beginning with the day on which the change occurs, or as soon as reasonably practicable after the change occurs, whichever is later.
